title: Smallest AI Recognizer Options
description: Smallest AI Pulse realtime STT options. Only applies when recognizer vendor is 'smallestai'. Each option is sent only when set; otherwise the vendor default applies. The model comes from recognizer.model (pulse or pulse-2).

language.description: Vendor language code sent verbatim (e.g. 'north_indic', 'hi-dev', 'multi-asian'). Overrides the language mapped from the recognizer language.

eouTimeoutMs.description: Silence in milliseconds before end of utterance.

itnNormalize.description: Apply inverse text normalization (numbers, dates, etc. as written forms).

noFormatDelay.description: Return finals without waiting for formatting.

finalizeOnWords.description: Finalize a transcript once maxWords is reached.

maxWords.description: Word count at which a transcript is finalized.

keywords.description: Keywords to boost, each 'term' or 'term:intensifier'. When absent, recognizer hints are used.

expireContent.description: Value sent in the x-expire-content header.

externalSessionId.description: Client id for correlating the session in Smallest AI logs
